title: Quantum Cellular Automata Realizing the Full Witt Group
exact_target: Construct higher-dimensional cellular automata realizing every nondegenerate braided-fusion Witt class, beyond the pointed classes.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006639 (OWR-14299913-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Higher Structures from Symmetries in Quantum Field Theory (2026), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2026/12, pp. 737--794. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The requested realization must identify the Witt correspondence and the automaton equivalence class. The source also flags unresolved order and dimension questions for existing examples.
